body:
Source: GitHub issues #743 (bug, P1-high, false-green) and #746 (bug, P1-high, data loss), both in packages/rejection-mining/bin/rejection-mining.mjs. Re-verified on main @ de8a130a. (a) bin :52-58: the `--prompt-only` branch runs BEFORE `checkGhAvailable` (:62) and `fetchSignals` (:70), builds its prompt from a hardcoded placeholder cluster `{ slug: 'example-cluster' }` and one fake signal `<sample PR rejection comment>`, and exits 0 — no PR read, no cluster formed. The sister tool lesson-foundry clusters first and prints the REAL prompts. Three host plugins (plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-distill.md:102, plugins/adlc-opencode/command/adlc-distill.md:12, plugins/adlc-copilot/skills/adlc-distill/SKILL.md:22) instruct the operator to run exactly this flag as the C13 mining step, so an agent answers a prompt about a fake objection and records rejection mining as done over zero PRs. No test exercises the bin. (b) bin :147 `writeFileSync(plan.path, plan.content, 'utf8')` with no existence check, no `--force`, no temp+rename; lib/lens.mjs:113-115 builds `${outDir}/lens-${slug}.md` from `cluster.slug` with nothing de-duplicating slugs across clusters (lib/cluster.mjs:135 `deriveSlug` = first four tokens of the cluster's FIRST signal), so two clusters with the same opening words overwrite each other while the human table and `--json` `lenses[]` claim both; the JSON is printed (:112-120) BEFORE any write lands.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/rejection-mining` (an npm workspace): bin/rejection-mining.mjs; lib/gh.mjs (checkGhAvailable, runGh), lib/mine.mjs (fetchSignals, buildClusters), lib/cluster.mjs (deriveSlug — rail, do not change), lib/lens.mjs (planLensEmissions, renderLensFile), lib/llm.mjs (buildAllPrompts, promptOnly, refineClusters), lib/report.mjs (buildHumanReport, buildJsonResult), lib/int-flag.mjs. Tests (all lib-level today): test/{lens,llm-failure-exit,report,cluster,signal,mine,...}.test.mjs; `npm test -w packages/rejection-mining`. For the new bin test drive the real bin with a fake `gh` executable prepended to PATH (fixture JSON for the `gh` subcommands lib/gh.mjs and lib/mine.mjs actually invoke — read them first). A fake CLI shim MUST drain its stdin (`cat > /dev/null` or equivalent) or `spawnSync({ input })` can EPIPE under load.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. `--prompt-only` moves below `buildClusters`: it still requires `gh` (a missing gh is the existing operational error, exit 1 — never a fake prompt) and prints `buildAllPrompts(clusters, signals)` — one prompt per cluster, in cluster order, separated exactly as `promptOnly` already formats — then exits 0. With zero clusters it prints ONE stderr line `rejection-mining: no clusters at --min <n> over <totalPRs> PR(s); nothing to prompt` and exits 0 with NOTHING on stdout. The placeholder cluster and signal are deleted.
2. Slug de-duplication is ONE exported pure function in lib/lens.mjs, `dedupeSlugs(slugs)`: returns a new array where the second and later occurrence of a slug become `<slug>-2`, `<slug>-3`, … in input order; `planLensEmissions` applies it so every plan `path` is unique. `cluster.slug` on the input clusters is not mutated; each plan carries the deduped `slug`.
3. Writes are atomic and refuse to clobber: ONE exported pure predicate in lib/lens.mjs, `writeDecision({ exists, force })` → `'write' | 'skip-exists'`. For each plan: if the path exists and `--force` (new boolean flag, default false) is absent → decision `skip-exists`, nothing written, human line `  skipped (exists): <path>`; otherwise write to `<path>.tmp-<pid>` in the same directory and `renameSync` over the target. A write failure is still the existing operational error (exit 1) and the skipped/written state of earlier plans is reported.
4. Output ordering: when `--write` is given, the `--json` result (and the human table) is emitted AFTER the write loop, and each `lenses[]` entry gains `written: true | false` and `skipped: 'exists' | null`. Without `--write` the JSON is unchanged except for those two fields (`written: false, skipped: null`). `buildJsonResult`'s other fields are unchanged.
5. Documentation: `packages/rejection-mining/README.md` (flag table :28-33, examples :45-54) and by hand `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/rejection-mining.mdx` (:24-35): `--prompt-only` now reads real PR rejections via gh and prints one prompt per cluster; `--force` is documented; `--write` skips existing lens files without it. `plugins/adlc-pi/prompts/adlc-distill.md:31` carries a caution that `--prompt-only` exits before any gh call — rewrite that sentence to the new truth (hand edit, one line). The other three plugin distill docs already describe the gh-backed behaviour this change makes true; do not touch them.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 With a fake gh returning two PRs whose review comments form one cluster, `--prompt-only` prints a prompt that quotes a real fixture comment body and exits 0; the strings `example-cluster` and `<sample PR rejection comment>` appear nowhere in the output or the bin. verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/bin-prompt-only-write.test.mjs`
- AC2 With a fake gh whose comments form zero clusters, `--prompt-only` exits 0, stdout is empty, stderr contains `nothing to prompt`. With gh absent from PATH, `--prompt-only` exits 1 (existing gh error). verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/bin-prompt-only-write.test.mjs`
- AC3 `dedupeSlugs(['a','b','a','a'])` → `['a','b','a-2','a-3']`, input not mutated; `planLensEmissions` on two clusters with identical slugs yields two distinct paths. verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/bin-prompt-only-write.test.mjs`
- AC4 `--write` into an out-dir where `lens-<slug>.md` already exists with custom content leaves that file byte-identical, reports `skipped (exists)`, JSON entry `written:false, skipped:'exists'`, exit 0; the same run with `--force` replaces it and no `*.tmp-*` file remains. verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/bin-prompt-only-write.test.mjs`
- AC5 With `--write --json`, the JSON is the LAST thing on stdout and its `written` flags match the files on disk. verify: `node --test packages/rejection-mining/test/bin-prompt-only-write.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green and untouched. verify: `npm test -w packages/rejection-mining`
- AC7 Docs updated in both places plus the pi caution. verify: `grep -c "\-\-force" packages/rejection-mining/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/rejection-mining.mdx` (each >= 1) and `grep -c "placeholder" plugins/adlc-pi/prompts/adlc-distill.md` (= 0)
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: changing `deriveSlug` (lib/cluster.mjs is a rail), the LLM refinement path, the claude-code/opencode/copilot distill docs, #745 (charter prose), #744/#747 if present.
title: rejection-mining: --prompt-only mines real PR rejections, and --write never clobbers a lens
